courses.title: Second-Order Linear Differential Equations
courses.description: A first course on second-order linear equations: characteristic roots, initial value problems, forcing and resonance, and damped springs.

courses.title: Control Bootcamp
courses.description: Companions to Steve Brunton's Control Bootcamp lectures and Chapter 8 of Brunton & Kutz, from the idea of feedback to stability of linear systems.

lectures.title: Overview
lectures.description: Why feedback beats open-loop control, the state-space model, and how closing the loop moves an inverted pendulum's eigenvalues.

lectures.title: Linear Systems
lectures.description: Solving x-dot = Ax with the matrix exponential: eigenvector coordinates, decoupled modes, and the map, evolve, map back picture.

lectures.title: Stability and Eigenvalues
lectures.description: When solutions decay: the left half-plane in continuous time, the unit circle in discrete time, and the map between them.
